edits.content:
## Translate Quantitative Guarantees Before Ranking
Put quantitative candidates into standard form before deciding which is strongest. For example, distinguish an asymptotic equivalence from an upper bound, compare decay exponents, separate a parameter-dependent exponent of the input size from a parameter factor multiplying a fixed polynomial, and preserve the order of nested limits and cutoffs. Select a sharper rate or broader conclusion only when it follows under the stated assumptions; do not infer it from plausibility alone.
